input.question: How can diamond be cut if its the hardest material?
input.ground_truth: Diamond have the highest hardness but have low toughness. Hardness is how hart it is to scratch the surface of the diamond and you cant scratch it with steel. Toughness if how good it is to breakage from forceful impact . It has less toughness then steel. So if you place a diamond on a anvil and smash it with a hammer it will shatter. So you can cleave diamond with a metallic blade and a wooden mallet like in this video [_URL_0_](_URL_0_) You cut diamond by gluing diamond fragments on the edge rotating disk or some wire.You can grind the surface by putting diamond fragment on the flat side of a rotating disk . So you cut and grind diamonds with other diamonds and both will consumed and reduced to smaller parts. A video of more of the process [_URL_1_](_URL_1_)

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: How can diamond be cut if its the hardest material?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Sure! Let’s break it down simply:

Diamonds are the hardest stones we know, which means they are very, very hard to scratch. But “hard” doesn’t mean they can’t be broken or cut. 

Imagine you have a big, hard chocolate bar. It’s hard to bite into, but if you use a sharp knife and press hard, you can cut it. Diamonds are a little like that. 

We use special tools made of other very hard materials and push them really, really hard and in just the right way to cut the diamond. It takes a lot of skill and the right tools, but it can be done!
